intro: Days an employee worked when they did not have to. Approving one credits their COMP_OFF balance with the earned days, which then expire on the date shown — an unused comp-off is not carried forward past it.
emptyDescriptionFiltered: This employee has not claimed any comp-off yet.
emptyDescriptionAll: Comp-off appears here when an employee claims a day they worked on a holiday or weekly off.
footerNote: Approved comp-off shows up as a COMP_OFF row in the balances table above, where it behaves like any other leave type until it expires.
